definitions.gloss: to understand each other; to see eye to eye
definitions.explanation: Of two or more people, to understand one another's feelings and thinking. Very often in the potential {分|わ}かり{合|あ}える, in hopeful or negative statements about relationships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{分|わ}かり{合|あ}う。
examples.english: Parent and child understand each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はな}せば→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧{分|わ}かり{合|あ}える。
examples.english: If we talk, I'm sure we can understand each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じなくて→通ずる：31647_tsuuzuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{分|わ}かり{合|あ}える⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じている→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: I believe that even without a common language, people can understand each other's feelings.

notes:
⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (each other). The partner takes ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧, or the people are the subject together: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{分|わ}かり{合|あ}う, ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{分|わ}かり{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧. What is shared can take ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, as in ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分|わ}かり{合|あ}う. Often written わかり{合|あ}う.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分|わ}かり{合|あ}える⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧: a relationship of mutual understanding
- ⟦{互|たが}い→互い：03402_tagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分|わ}かり{合|あ}う: to understand one another
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分|わ}かり{合|あ}う: to understand each other's feelings
- {分|わ}かり{合|あ}えない: to be unable to understand each other

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧し⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to understand each other — more formal, often of ideas and positions
- {通|つう}じ{合|あ}う: to be in tune — of feelings passing between people
